column3: Pressure temperature ratings and lining thickness are based on 3P slip fit pipe.
The interior surfaces of all housings will be clean and free of mold burrs, dust, scale or other protrusions that adversely affect the integrity or performance of the linings.

Linings will show no evidence of pinholes, porosity or cracks.  Any bulges or indications of poor contact with the housing will be cause for rejection.  All finished linings will be spark tested at a voltage not less than 10000 volts DC.
Metal surfaces of pipe and fittings will be epoxy coated, suitable for chemical service.  Where piping is to be insulated, a red oxide primer is sufficient.
All spools will have safety vent holes.  Where pipe or fittings are to be insulated, couplings and  nipples will be provided at vent holes to protude outside of insulation.
Gaskets will be used for all connections.
